summary.text: Open Trusted Contacts in Account settings, then choose the appointment request to accept it.

steps.name: Open Trusted Contacts
steps.text: Open the “Trusted Contacts” section under Account settings.

steps.name: Accept the request
steps.text: Choose “Added you as a Trusted Contact” to accept the appointment request.
